explication: agx is a desktop and web data-exploration application. The principal workflow is entering SQL, executing it through a local ClickHouse process or remote proxy, and viewing tabular results; schema browsing and AI-assisted querying are additional capabilities. The graph includes documented product areas and sampled engine/backend relationships; some UI-to-subsystem wiring is not shown in the excerpts, so those relationships are omitted.
